description: This PHP test class, JobSpecificationAPITest, is part of the test suite for the OrangeHRM project. It tests the API endpoints related to job specifications, focusing on operations like retrieving a single job specification and handling unimplemented methods such as update and delete. It sets up test data and utilizes mocks to verify API behaviors.
external_methods: Enhanced API methods like getApiEndpointMock, getMockAuthUser, getRequest
